audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of all Bus Stop event records: the opening farm arrival, Sam’s concert departure, Shane’s gridball trip, and the seasonal map action. Every line, embedded question, response option, conditional branch, gender branch, and character voice was reviewed in full event context with canonical Robin, Mayor Lewis, Pelican Town, farm, gridball and Tunnelers terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, friendship and event conditions, response IDs, placeholders, branch delimiters, emotion markers, sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. One command-only map action is explicitly preserved. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
